requirements.statement: Under Lifetime::Run no process of the run MUST be able to start a session; starting a process group MUST work with the defaults.

acceptance.given: a forking default policy on T1 and T2
acceptance.then: setsid fails with EPERM and setpgid succeeds
acceptance.when: a process of the run calls setsid and setpgid(0, 0)

acceptance.given: the lowering with fork and Lifetime::Run
acceptance.then: setsid is denied in both, setpgid only with Tty::Inherit
acceptance.when: it is lowered with Tty::None and Tty::Inherit

tasks.text: [SR-001] [US1] Lowering denies `setsid`, and `setpgid` only with `Tty::Inherit`; lowering test — crates/procage-policy/src/lower/linux.rs, crates/procage-policy/tests/gaps.rs

existing_verification.justification: In a forking default cage on T1 and T2, a process of the run that leads neither its session nor its group calls setsid (EPERM) and setpgid(0, 0) (ok); procage-policy/tests/gaps.rs the_linux_lifetime_lock_follows_the_setting asserts setsid denied with Tty::None and Tty::Inherit and setpgid only with Tty::Inherit. Passed in both container lanes (Linux 7.0, ABI 8), 2026-11-02.

requirements.statement: Ending a run MUST kill every live process of the child session, including those in other process groups and outside the child tree.

acceptance.given: a descendant in a process group of its own whose parent exited
acceptance.then: it dies within two seconds on T1 and T2

tasks.text: [SR-002] [US1] Ending a run kills the child's session (live members, repeated for members forked meanwhile) — crates/procage/src/linux/child.rs
[SR-001] [SR-002] [US1] Canaries: `setpgid` allowed and `setsid` refused; a grouped, reparented descendant dies with the run — crates/procage/tests/escape_linux.rs

existing_verification.justification: An intermediate starts /bin/sleep with process_group(0) and exits, so the sleeper is outside the child's group and tree; dropping the handle kills it within two seconds on T1 and T2. The existing R-23 canaries (double fork, exited child, descendants) pass unchanged.
